situation: An offer to run the Department of Government Efficiency personally, in the incoming administration, while remaining CEO of Tesla. Tesla's core buyer base skews toward the political constituency most opposed to that administration.
what_he_actually_did: Took the role personally and publicly, alongside political endorsements in Europe. Stepped back in April 2025 after Tesla's Q1 results.
outcome_detail: Tesla Q1 2025 profits fell 71% and vehicle sales 20%. European sales fell 49% year on year in April while the overall European EV market grew 34%. Tesla's brand value fell $15.4B — about 36% — over 2025, a third consecutive annual decline. He said he would spend less time on DOGE.

expect.notes: The structurally new failure, and the reason this period needed its own cases. Every earlier mistake put the cost where the decision was made: Tesla decided, Tesla paid. Here the decision was personal and political, and the bill arrived at Tesla -- its shareholders, its customers, its brand. The usual corrective, that the people bearing the cost push back, does not work when the decider owns both sides. The engine has irreversible-unquestioned and it fires, but it has no way to say who pays.

decision.decision: Run DOGE personally while remaining Tesla CEO

requirements.text: This has to be done by me personally and publicly
Political positions must be stated openly rather than held privately
Tesla must keep growing in Europe

steps.name: Take a named, public role in the administration
Endorse candidates and parties in overseas elections
Do the work through a delegate rather than personally
